title: v2.2.0 — Print Alignment, Active Entries & In-App Auto-Updater
summary: Major update addressing client examination printout formatting, candidate row-wise ordering, repeat banners across multi-page prints, and one-click in-app updates.

highlights.title: Class Seating Plan: Only Allotted Entries
highlights.detail: Unallotted classes (such as Class 11 & 12) no longer appear with 'ROOM NOT ALLOTTED' or print blank pages. Only classes with active student allotments are printed in natural grade sequence.

highlights.title: Roomwise Notice Board: Strict Room Alignment
highlights.detail: Students in rooms (e.g., Room 6A) are now ordered strictly by seating arrangement (first all 6A candidates rolls 1-21, then all 7A candidates rolls 1-21). Removed alphabetical name sorting that caused class jumbling.

highlights.title: Exam Attendance Sheet: Row-Aligned Order
highlights.detail: Candidate listing in Attendance Sheets now strictly mirrors the room notice board arrangement sequence for smooth on-ground invigilation.

highlights.title: Multi-Page Header & School Banner Repeat
highlights.detail: When lists exceed 1 page, Page 2 and subsequent pages automatically carry the full school wide banner, exam title, room/class metadata, and table header.

highlights.title: One-Click In-App Software Updater
highlights.detail: Easily check for new releases, view detailed changelogs, and download/install updates directly inside the application with one click.

highlights.title: Clean Summary Footer on Attendance Sheet
highlights.detail: Total, Present, Absent, and Invigilator Signature blocks are positioned only on the final page of each room to maximize candidate row spacing.

history.title: v2.1.0 — Excel Import & Hardware Licensing
history.summary: Added Dynamic Report Excel parsing, single-device hardware lock, and consolidated score sheet export.

history.title: v2.0.0 — Official Crescent High School Replicas
history.summary: Redesigned print layouts and Word .docx exports to match official school formats and wide banner letterheads.
